# ghost/notes

Fossify Notes (F-Droid): create a text note, append to it, list notes, read a note. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/notes
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/notes create_note --device <serial> --param title=<title> --param text=<text>
ghost skill run ghost/notes append_to_note --device <serial> --param title=<title> --param text=<text>
ghost skill run ghost/notes list_notes --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/notes read_note --device <serial> --param title=<title>
```

## Actions

- `create_note`: Make a note called Groceries with milk eggs bread
- `append_to_note`: Add butter to my Groceries note
- `list_notes`: What notes do I have?
- `read_note`: Read my Groceries note
